data.one_liner: Add Zalo login, get user info, and handle authentication in Flutter
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to authenticate users via Zalo (using native app or webview), validate refresh tokens, log out, and fetch user profile information.
use_when: You need to support Zalo social login in your Flutter application.
You want to retrieve Zalo user profiles and profile pictures.
avoid_when: You do not need Zalo integration and can rely on standard authentication providers like Google or Apple.
strengths: Simplifies Zalo login and API integration for Flutter developers.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration for Android (Gradle, Manifest, Kotlin/Java application wrapper) and iOS (Info.plist, AppDelegate).
Under development, some APIs might not be available yet.
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a Zalo app, configuring Android Manifest, strings.xml, overriding Android Activity/Application in Kotlin or Java, and modifying iOS Info.plist and AppDelegate.swift.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need Google authentication instead of Zalo.

alternatives.name: sign_in_with_apple
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need Sign in with Apple instead of Zalo.
